content: Finding Port Gelhorn's missing tourists and the serial killer in Grand Theft Auto 6 takes you on a twisted journey around the town, one with few guideposts and a lot of chances to get stuck. It's a macabre scavenger hunt with only a few pictures and knowledge of the surrounding area to go by, though the reward at the end is comparatively small. This is a quest where the storytelling, more than anything else, is the reward.
